$comment: Who speaks with which voice, across all lessons. Written by the recording script; you only change "status". New characters arrive as "pending" with a sample to listen to (open the site with ?casting). Set "approved" to record their lines, or "rejected" to get the next-best voice and a new sample. "future" marks a character who is only mentioned so far: they get a voice the first time they speak in a lesson.

harriet.name: Harriet
harriet.description: A retired schoolteacher from Manchester in her sixties, on her first trip to Paris. Nervous but determined; speaks careful learner French with a British accent.

gilles.name: Gilles
gilles.description: A retired Parisian man in his seventies who feeds the pigeons at the Trocadéro every morning. Dry, deadpan, unhurried; a low, calm voice.

madame-benali.name: Madame Benali
madame-benali.description: The building’s gardienne, an older Parisian woman in her sixties. Warm, theatrical, expressive; knows everything about everyone and loves telling it.

clement.name: Clément
clement.description: A young man of 26 from Bordeaux, just moved to Paris. Polite, slightly overwhelmed; a natural, standard French accent.

monsieur-petrovic.name: Monsieur Petrovic
monsieur-petrovic.description: A retired opera chorus singer on the third floor, in his seventies. Grand, theatrical, a big rich voice; still sings at 2am.

madame-martin.name: Madame Martin
madame-martin.description: Half of the couple on the fourth floor who have been renovating for six years. Middle-aged, cheerful, always busy, a little vague about the works.

monsieur-martin.name: Monsieur Martin
monsieur-martin.description: The other half of the Martins on the fourth floor. Middle-aged, friendly, enthusiastic about DIY he never seems to finish.

ines.name: Inès
ines.description: A young woman on the fifth floor who gets a parcel every single day. Bright, friendly, a little secretive.

le-locataire-du-sixieme.name: Le locataire du sixième
le-locataire-du-sixieme.description: The sixth-floor tenant no one has ever seen, only his cat. Age and voice unknown: decide when he finally appears.
